description: The Sint-Nicolaasbasiliek at IJsselstein is the neo-Gothic brick hall church built in 1885-1887 to a design by Alfred Tepe. The tall tower has deep niches, brick tracery, a balustrade, and corner pinnacles. It is overcast, about 12.6°C, with wind near 4.3 km/h and cloud cover about 100%. The church is closed. The older reformed church in the town is not this frame.
